line 4: Products: equity derivatives, rates, credit, FX, and portfolio hedges.

line 6: Review period: 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30.

line 8: ## Control framework
line 9: Daily VaR, SVaR, stress, and exposure limits are monitored in SGMR.
line 10: Colibris records excess workflow, explanation, validation, and limit-change events.
line 11: All permanent limit changes require desk-head and risk pre-approval before effect.
line 12: Post-trade overrides require recorded approval before closure.
line 13: 
line 14: ## Reporting conventions
line 15: Commentary extracts contain selected movement-review records, not all daily observations.
line 16: Movement thresholds are distinct from absolute risk limits.
line 17: Hierarchy and unit comparisons must remain at a documented comparable grain.
